changelog:
Initial release of 澪白主控Agent:

- Supports real-time direct conversation and proactive chat companionship.
- Recognizes user intent to distinguish between chat and task requests.
- Dispatches tasks to specialized sub-Agents as needed.
- Can be triggered by real-time messages, heartbeat signals, or scheduled tasks.
- Main workflow: Input → Intent Recognition → Route to Chat or Task Handling.
summary: Provides real-time chat, intent recognition, task delegation to sub-agents, and proactive companionship through direct dialogue and agent coordination.
